answer: A cloned login cannot occupy first light on a surveyed shore. The agent posts 39.4 POA and gets a 47-minute bench at marker 12C, where a prism sits 1.8 m above the staff. Between dawn and a tide height of 2.35 m they record 22 spectral frames at 15-second intervals; peak angle must stay within 0.4 degrees of the ephemeris. A second key on the same bench serial is slashed 39.4 POA and both seats close. If cloud blocks the limb before frame 14, the window rolls to the next dawn and a new serial is required. Verifiers recompute the prism trace from the tide-synced clock, not a reused photo.
